scope: National Assembly election of 10 and 24 May 1998 under Act XXXIV of 1989 (as amended by Acts III of 1994 and XCVI of 1997), all 386 seats: round-1 registers, participation, printed turnout and both round-1 ballots' counts (all 176 constituencies, all 20 territorial districts); round-2 register, participation and printed turnout of the 175 constituencies holding round 2, and the registers and printed percentages of the 2 territorial districts holding round 2; territorial-list votes of every list as the valid-round composite (round 1 in 18 districts, round 2 in 2) with the printed shares and the 18-district round-1 part; national single-member votes per party in each round as apportioned by the office, with the office's Fidesz/MDF nomination-group table for round 2; national compensation fragment votes and seats; the final composition (176 + 128 + 82) with original groups. Per-constituency rows, per-list round-1 votes in the 2 re-run districts, the round-2 single-member invalid count and candidates are not covered.

owner_decisions.decision: Owner reply: national figures on Copyright Act § 1(4), a reading of the statute weaker than a licence; no candidate names.
Owner reply: extend that reading to the office's composition pages for aggregate seat counts.
Owner answer 'National figures per tier (Recommended)' for the 2010 archive, the scope applied here.

Owner brief 'Hungary 1998 source semantics, data admission, and canonical wording' naming ovbk1.htm, l22.htm, l120.htm, l23a.htm, eredind.htm, elemind.htm and l100.htm on static.valasztas.hu, and asking that the valid-round composite and the apportioned single-member table be resolved before admission, and that admission be completed when the evidence and existing authorisation permit it.

reuse_right.basis: As for 2002-2010: official result publications of the election office and the National Election Commission's notice, read under the owner's Copyright Act § 1(4) reading; no licence exists. Statutes are not subject to copyright.

normalized_republication.basis: National counts, national sums per ballot and per tier, and seat counts, as for 2002-2010. The two round-2 territorial districts are recorded as the whole geography of that part of the list ballot (registers and printed percentages only). No per-constituency rows; no candidate names. The round-1 notice names the one deputy elected in round 1; the name is not recorded.

raw_redistribution.basis: The pages were read in a browser and are not saved; only the transcribed figures, short quoted clauses and a SHA-256 of each page's rendered text are committed.

acquisition_route.basis: The seven owner-named pages and four pages linked visibly from them (v98din1/l22.htm, l100t.htm, l50.htm, l61.htm), each read once by hand. l100e.htm (per-constituency round-2 rows, linked from l100.htm) was opened and not transcribed. No candidate, member or per-party page was opened. Statutes as for 2002-2010 (njt.jog.gov.hu, read 2026-11-22). www.valasztas.hu not contacted; no data endpoint requested.

source_files_complete.basis: Round-1 notice (registers, both ballots, constituency and district outcomes); round-2 summary and territorial summary; national totals after round 1 and after round 2 (every party, both single-member rounds, territorial and fragment columns); threshold page (every territorial list with printed shares); nomination-group page (Fidesz/MDF); compensation page (every national list); composition page (every group, original joint row). Missing nationally and recorded as unavailable: per-list round-1 votes in the 2 re-run districts, round-2 territorial participants, the round-2 single-member invalid count, original single-member groups for round 1 and for parties other than Fidesz and MDF.

national_definition_complete.basis: reconcile1998: registers add up in both rounds and reproduce 56.26% and 57.01%; each round-1 ballot's urn plus missing minus voters equals the printed excess (9, 12) and invalid plus valid equals the urn, with percentages of voters reproduced; 1 + 144 + 31 = 176 constituencies and round 2 in exactly 175; round 2 in exactly the 2 districts whose round 1 was invalid; 15 territorial lists = 4,547,682 with every printed share reproduced; 18-district round-1 part 4,064,201 and derived round-2 part 483,481 within the range implied by the printed district percentages; printed 5% border 227,384 reproduces and matches every finding; no joint list; 128 territorial seats; 58 + 24 = 82 compensation seats reproduced by D'Hondt (11/10/14/30/17); single-member votes 4,467,940 and 4,509,982; Fidesz and MDF nomination groups reproduce their round-2 votes and seats; composition 176 + 128 + 82 = 386, none vacant, with 335 list-linked seats, 50 joint Fidesz-MDF/MDF-Fidesz seats and 1 independent.

same_election_identity_complete.basis: Territorial lists (all single-party; the office states none was joint or linked) and single-member party rows are separate contestants. Single-member rows are labelled source_apportioned_party_total: the office divided joint candidates' votes among the nominating parties and shows their seats under the first-named party; these seats are kept as first_named_party_* and never as original-group seats. Original groups are kept where the office prints them (Fidesz/MDF round 2; the composition). No link to any other election.

electoral_system_metadata_complete.basis: Same version as 2002-2010: § 4 original text; § 8(3) and Annex 4 set by Act III of 1994 (in force 1994-01-20); § 8(5) and § 9(2)-(6) set by Act XCVI of 1997 (in force 1997-11-05, before both 1998 polling days). The 10% and 15% thresholds were in force; the office did not calculate them because no joint or linked list stood.

vintage_decisions_complete.basis: Round-1 notice of the National Election Commission, final ('végleges'), made 18 May 1998; round-2 pages headed 'Végleges' (final); composition prints 386 filled and 0 vacant. The round-1 national table prints no finality heading and differs from the final table by 98 round-1 votes between Fidesz and SZDSZ (same total); the final table is used and the difference recorded.

continuity: None: no party register reviewed; no link to 2002 or later elections, even where a label repeats.
